SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    concat('Q', toString(dominant_qtr)) AS dominant_quarter,
    round(avg_max_pct, 2) AS avg_pct_of_annual_from_best_quarter
FROM (
    SELECT
        ProductCategoryName,
        argMax(qtr, avg_qtr_pct) AS dominant_qtr,
        max(avg_qtr_pct) AS avg_max_pct
    FROM (
        SELECT
            pc.ProductCategoryName,
            toQuarter(f.DateKey) AS qtr,
            sum(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0
                / nullIf(sum(sum(f.SalesAmount)) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName, toYear(f.DateKey)), 0)
                AS pct_of_annual,
            avg(
                sum(f.SalesAmount) * 100.0
                / nullIf(sum(sum(f.SalesAmount)) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName, toYear(f.DateKey)), 0)
            ) OVER (PARTITION BY pc.ProductCategoryName, toQuarter(f.DateKey)) AS avg_qtr_pct
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
        JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
        JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
        GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName, toYear(f.DateKey), toQuarter(f.DateKey)
    )
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryName, qtr
    HAVING qtr = argMax(qtr, avg_qtr_pct)  -- keep only the dominant quarter row per category
) sub
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName, dominant_qtr, avg_max_pct
ORDER BY avg_pct_of_annual_from_best_quarter DESC
